name: Wilson Llanos
headline: AI Engineer
tagline: I build applied AI systems, from prototype to production.
summary: I am a Systems Developer at EISA, building production generative AI solutions on the Azure ecosystem with a focus on data security and governance. I built a multi-agent system with LangGraph and MCP for IT incident triage, reducing response time, and I am now building a multi-agent system with hybrid RAG to automate tier-1 support. I also work on data integration across four systems, including legacy ones, eliminating recurring errors, and I have Machine Learning projects with Apache Spark on Databricks. MBA in AI and Big Data from ICMC/USP (completed in 2026) and a degree in Civil Engineering.
